_comment: Beta RISC-V SoC QEMU Platform Configuration Template. Replace all 0xDEAD#### placeholder addresses with real hardware values. Fields marked TODO require user input.

acpu._comment: Application CPU subsystem: 32 RV64GC cores in 8 clusters of 4 cores each, RVA23S64 profile
acpu._comment_isa: Full RVA23S64 mandatory+optional extensions. Adjust as needed for the actual core implementation.

mmu._comment: Sv39 provides 39-bit virtual address space (512GB). ASID/VMID widths are implementation-specific.

pmu._comment: Hardware performance counters (mhpmcounter3..mhpmcounter31). Set to actual core's HPM count.

cache._comment: Per-core cache parameters. Set to actual core implementation values.

l2_per_cluster._comment: Shared L2 cache per cluster (if present). Set to 0 if not applicable.

l3_shared._comment: Shared L3 across all clusters (if present). Set to 0 if not applicable.

cache._comment_cbo: Cache block sizes for Zicbom (management) and Zicboz (zero) operations.

mcpu._comment: Management CPU: 1 RV32 IMAC core for boot and platform management

memory_map._comment: Full SoC memory map. All base addresses are placeholders (0xDEAD####). Replace with actual values from the SoC address map document.

regions.name: mcpu_plic
regions._comment: MCPU PLIC: 64 interrupt sources, M-mode context only

regions.name: clint
regions._comment: CLINT for ACPU timer and software interrupts (all 32 harts)

regions.name: aplic_m_app
regions._comment: APLIC M-mode application domain (child of M-root)

regions.name: aplic_s_app
regions._comment: APLIC S-mode application domain (child of M-root)

regions.name: imsic_m
regions._comment: IMSIC M-mode interrupt files for all 32 ACPU harts

regions.name: imsic_s
regions._comment: IMSIC S-mode interrupt files for all 32 ACPU harts (includes VS guest files)

regions.name: bt_spi
regions._comment: Boot SPI controller (connected to 128MB NOR flash)

regions.name: bt_spi_flash
regions._comment: 128MB NOR flash memory-mapped region via Boot SPI (XIP capable)

regions.name: mailbox
regions._comment: Mailbox / semaphore controller for inter-processor communication

regions.name: ddr_ch0
regions._comment: DDR4 channel 0: up to 64GB. Adjust base/size per actual map.

interrupts._comment: Interrupt subsystem configuration for ACPU (AIA + CLINT) and MCPU (PLIC)

aia._comment: Advanced Interrupt Architecture for the 32 ACPU harts

aplic._comment_irqs: 136 wired interrupt sources routed through APLIC (IRQ IDs 1..136, ID 0 is reserved)

domains.name: m_root
domains._comment: M-mode root domain. Parent of m_app and s_app. Delegates IRQs to children.

domains.name: m_app
domains._comment: M-mode application domain for firmware interrupt handling

domains.name: s_app
domains._comment: S-mode application domain for OS/hypervisor interrupt handling

imsic._comment_ids: 2048 MSI identity IDs per interrupt file (11-bit eiid, IDs 1..2047)
imsic._comment_guest: GEILEN=5: 5 VS-mode guest interrupt files per hart for hypervisor use

m_file._comment: M-mode interrupt file array. One file per hart, stride between consecutive harts.

s_file._comment: S-mode + VS-mode interrupt file array. Each hart has 1 S-file + 5 VS guest files.

clint._comment: Core Local Interruptor for ACPU: provides mtime, mtimecmp, and MSIP for all 32 harts
clint._comment_freq: Timer frequency in Hz. 10 MHz is common; set to actual SoC timer clock.

mcpu_plic._comment: Platform-Level Interrupt Controller for the single MCPU hart
mcpu_plic._comment_ctx: Single M-mode context for the single MCPU hart

irq_map._comment: Global interrupt source map. 135 interrupt lines (IDs 1..135 for APLIC, separate numbering for MCPU PLIC). Source field is TODO -- fill in from SoC interrupt assignment table.

devices._comment: All SoC peripherals. Each entry includes type, base address, size, IRQ assignment, and for generic_mmio devices, a representative register map.

peripherals.name: uart0
peripherals._comment: UART. Set clock_frequency to the actual input clock (e.g., 25000000 for 25MHz). IRQ is the APLIC source ID.

peripherals.name: i2c0
peripherals._comment: I2C controller 0. Set compatible string to actual IP (e.g., snps,designware-i2c).

peripherals.name: bt_spi
peripherals._comment: Boot SPI controller connected to 128MB NOR flash. Supports XIP (execute-in-place).

flash._comment: 128MB NOR flash. XIP base is the memory-mapped read window.

peripherals.name: rom
peripherals._comment: 64KB on-chip Boot ROM containing initial boot code

peripherals.name: wdt
peripherals._comment: Watchdog timer. Set compatible string to actual IP (e.g., snps,dw-wdt).

peripherals.name: mailbox
peripherals._comment: Mailbox / hardware semaphore for MCPU-ACPU inter-processor communication

peripherals.name: pvt_sensor
peripherals._comment: PVT (Process/Voltage/Temperature) sensor for thermal and voltage monitoring

peripherals.name: usb0
peripherals._comment: USB 2.0 host controller 0. Set compatible string (e.g., generic-ehci, snps,dwc2).

peripherals.name: pcie0
peripherals._comment: PCIe Gen4 x16 root complex 0. Set compatible (e.g., snps,dw-pcie).

ddr._comment: DDR4 memory subsystem: 8 channels, 64-bit each, max 64GB per channel (512GB total)

interleave._comment: 4KB interleave step across all 8 channels. Configured via SoC CSR.

channels._comment: Channel 0: default 64GB. Adjust to actual populated size.

boot._comment: Boot subsystem: MCPU boots first from BootROM, then releases ACPU cores
boot._comment_mcpu_reset: MCPU starts execution at the BootROM base address on power-on reset
boot._comment_acpu_reset: ACPU reset vector is programmed by MCPU firmware via soc_csr.boot_addr before core release
boot._comment_bootrom: Path to the BootROM binary image to load into the ROM region at startup
boot._comment_fw: Address where MCPU loads the next-stage firmware (e.g., OpenSBI) from NOR flash into DDR
boot._comment_kernel: Address for the OS kernel image in DDR
boot._comment_fdt: Address for the flattened device tree blob in DDR
boot._comment_initrd: Address for the initial ramdisk in DDR (optional)

soc_csr._comment: SoC top-level control/status registers. Base address from memory_map.soc_csr. These control chip-level functions including reset, clocks, boot, DDR interleave, and address remap.

registers.name: CORE_RELEASE
registers._comment: ACPU core release control. Each bit releases the corresponding hart from reset. Written by MCPU firmware after initialization.

fields.name: hart_release
fields._comment: Bit[n]=1 releases ACPU hart n from reset (n=0..31)

registers.name: BOOT_ADDR_LO
registers._comment: ACPU boot address [31:0]. MCPU programs this before releasing ACPU cores.

registers.name: DDR_INTERLEAVE
registers._comment: DDR interleave configuration. Must be set before DDR initialization.

fields.name: channel_mask
fields._comment: Bitmask of active channels for interleave

registers.name: ADDR_REMAP0
registers._comment: Address remap register 0: remap source region

registers.name: ADDR_REMAP0_DST
registers._comment: Address remap register 0: remap destination base [31:12]

registers.name: ADDR_REMAP0_SIZE
registers._comment: Address remap register 0: region size as log2(bytes)

registers.name: PCIE_MODE
registers._comment: PCIe controller mode configuration (must be set before PCIe init)

registers.name: BOOT_STATUS
registers._comment: Boot status register for MCPU to communicate boot progress

sam._comment: SAM (Secure Access Manager) registers for PMA (Physical Memory Attributes). Non-standard RISC-V extension. Configures memory region access permissions and cacheability attributes per-hart or globally.
sam._comment_entries: Number of SAM PMA entries. Each entry defines a region with base, size, and attributes.

entries._comment: SAM entry 0: typically covers BootROM as read-only, executable, non-cacheable

fields.name: hart_mask_lo
fields._comment: Hart applicability mask [15:0] (1=applies to this hart)

entries._comment: SAM entry 1: structure identical to entry 0. Typically covers DDR as read-write, cacheable.
SAM entry 2: typically covers MMIO device region as non-cacheable, read-write

qos._comment: No QoS/CBQRI support on this SoC. This section is a placeholder.
